protocol.search: unchanged Hardest: width 2, depth 3, 12 scored candidates in Train; 48 in Adaptive Test
protocol.selection: own Clean Valid only; original threshold/epoch rules; Test once after all training
protocol.masks: ceil(fraction * hidden size); detached; same mask for both views; no rescaling; unchanged bias
protocol.eligibility: strict semantic selected view and actual truncated encoder-input change
protocol.reference: reuse detached dropout-free representations from current Hardest scoring; main and masked BCE reuse training-dropout representations
protocol.rsc: paper section 3.1 signed true-class Top-Gradient mask, in the same additive pair-BCE protocol; no spatial/batch curriculum
protocol.scope: Clean function classification; matched small pilot only; no cross-domain or full training

bootstrap: 2000 paired stratified Test-function resamples, seed 42; exploratory 95% percentile CI, not training-seed uncertainty
